---
title: ""
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
geometry: "a4paper,left=2.1cm,right=2.1cm,top=2.5cm,bottom=2.2cm"
fontsize: 16pt
params:
  titre: ""
  sous_titre: ""
  logo: ""
  contenu: !r data.frame()
  metadata: !r list()
---

```{r preparation, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
echapper = function(x) {
  x = as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] = ""
  table = c("\\" = "\\textbackslash{}", "{" = "\\{", "}" = "\\}",
    "#" = "\\#", "$" = "\\$", "%" = "\\%", "&" = "\\&",
    "_" = "\\_", "^" = "\\textasciicircum{}", "~" = "\\textasciitilde{}")
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    lettres = strsplit(v, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    paste0(vapply(lettres, function(ch) if (ch %in% names(table)) table[[ch]] else ch,
      character(1)), collapse = "")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

```{r document, results='asis'}
cat("\\noindent\\begin{minipage}[c]{0.78\\textwidth}\\Large\\bfseries ",
    echapper(params$titre), "\\\\[2pt]\\normalsize\\mdseries ",
    echapper(params$sous_titre), "\\end{minipage}", sep = "")
cat("\\hfill\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{", params$logo,
    "}}\\par\\vspace{0.4cm}\\hrule\\vspace{0.6cm}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\noindent\\footnotesize Source : LEGI / Légifrance | Extraction : ",
    echapper(params$metadata$extraction), " | MD5 : ",
    echapper(params$metadata$md5), "\\par\n", sep = "")
cat("\\noindent\\footnotesize\\url{", params$metadata$url,
    "}\\par\\normalsize\\vspace{0.5cm}\n", sep = "")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params$contenu))) {
  profondeur = as.integer(params$contenu$profondeur[[i]])
  if (is.na(profondeur) || profondeur < 0L) stop("Profondeur LEGI invalide")
  gras = "gras" %in% names(params$contenu) && isTRUE(params$contenu$gras[[i]])
  texte = echapper(params$contenu$texte[[i]])
  if (!nzchar(trimws(texte))) next
  retrait = min(profondeur, 10L) * 0.45
  cat("\\noindent\\hspace*{", format(retrait, decimal.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE),
      "cm}\\begin{minipage}[t]{\\dimexpr\\linewidth-",
      format(retrait, decimal.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE), "cm\\relax}", sep = "")
  if (gras) cat("\\bfseries ")
  cat(texte, "\\end{minipage}\\par\\vspace{0.12cm}\n", sep = "")
}
```
